### Whoever Has the Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/whoever-has-son
Passage: 1 John 5:11-12
Points:
- Jesus' exclusive claim as the only source of eternal life confronts human self-reliance and modern relativism.
- God's testimony makes clear that eternal life is found only in His Son, Jesus Christ.
- Because this granted life is truly eternal, it can never be lost by those who believe.
- Believing this biblical truth obligates Christians to actively share the gospel with others.

### A Love Letter from God (1 John 5:11) - Your Daily Bible Verse - August 15
Author: Anne Peterson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-august-15.html
Passage: 1 John 5:11
Points:
- God's written Word serves as His testimony of enduring love and divine purpose.
- Eternal life cannot be earned through human efforts or good deeds.
- Jesus provided the final, once-for-all sacrifice for sin so believers could receive life as a gift.
- Staying anchored in God's promises protects believers from doubts and spiritual deception.
